work.name: Moxe Health
work.summary: Architect for a B2B healthcare data interchange platform (HIPAA-regulated clinical data at scale), focused on data-platform capability, applied-AI evaluation, and cross-team technical coordination.
highlights: Identified, scoped, and validated applied-AI opportunities against real clinical and financial workloads, including a multimodal LLM proof-of-concept that surfaced $300K in recoverable invoices
Designed a FHIR-to-template clinical document generation pipeline, now in active development with partner engineers contributing to it
Built a healthcare quality-measure (HEDIS) proof-of-concept with Product: FHIR chart data to analyst-ready extracts, validated end-to-end against a simulated FHIR harness rather than by inspection
Partnered on Databricks implementation including Unity Catalog governance, lakehouse architecture, and self-service tooling for data analysis
Built Spark bulk-ingest and Delta-to-Iceberg conversion tooling supporting the ~600 TB clinical-data lakehouse migration off a $14M/yr legacy vendor
Led consent-management service team (Java, Spring Boot, NATS) with zero-downtime blue/green deployment
Built deploy-time safety mechanisms: canary deployment, smoke tests, and auto-rollback
Documented module boundaries and state diagrams for monolith decomposition planning on the core clinical data processing system
Coordinated architecture decisions across Data Platform, Chart Retrieval, and RevOps teams, presenting tradeoffs to both engineers and senior leadership
Coached senior engineers on architectural thinking and mentored across disciplines, including a formal data-science mentee

projects.name: Agentic Engineering Estate
projects.summary: A working multi-agent development system used daily to build and verify the projects on this page — the practice behind treating AI coding agents as production build tools.
highlights: Reusable building blocks: a library of ~40 agent skills (usage-instrumented and pruned by actual fire-count), MCP servers and tool adapters in daily production use, and sub-agent/workflow orchestration patterns
Custom eval harnesses rather than vibes: an own-commit SWE-bench-style benchmark for scoring local and frontier models on real repository work, plus adversarial-eval and domain-specific benches
Deterministic orchestration with worker/verifier separation; autonomous overnight loops shipped 8 independently fix-verified production bug fixes unattended
Belief-state engine pairing LLM extraction with deterministic code judges, over a hybrid lexical + semantic search layer
Multi-provider routing in practice (Anthropic, Google, and local open-weight models behind one gateway), plus local serving and LoRA fine-tuning on consumer hardware
